assets.alt: Space-time activator field, domain length, peak count, and final pattern for a growing-domain Turing simulation.

assets.caption: Pattern identity depends jointly on growth rate and kinetic margin.

assets.alt: Dispersion relation and coupled grid-time refinement for the growing-domain reaction-diffusion solver.
assets.caption: The fixed-domain instability baseline and refinement study bound the numerical interpretation.

assets.alt: Four reduced tissue-strip shapes under homogeneous and phase-shifted heterogeneous growth fields.
assets.caption: Weak heterogeneity relocates or suppresses folds while preserving endpoint constraints.

assets.alt: Annotated maps of fold-targeting error, peak curvature, and fold count across heterogeneity amplitude and phase.
assets.caption: Fold steering depends on the phase between load and stiffness fields.

assets.alt: Steering-curvature frontier, homogeneous buckling threshold, and quadrature-refinement panels.
assets.caption: Design claims are checked against the analytical threshold and grid refinement.

assets.alt: Stable and unstable CSTR equilibrium-temperature branches against coolant temperature.
assets.caption: Equilibrium multiplicity makes coolant selection a branch-selection problem.

assets.alt: Stress-test risk and nominal yield maps over residence time and coolant temperature.
assets.caption: The productive operating region and the robust region do not coincide.

assets.alt: Yield-risk frontier, cost-of-robustness bars, and independent equilibrium checks.
assets.caption: The selected robust point sacrifices nominal yield to reduce the declared synthetic risk.

assets.alt: Euler, RK4, and positive implicit trajectories for a stiff conservative three-state transfer.
assets.caption: Coarse explicit steps can create impossible negative mass even when total mass is formally conserved.

assets.alt: Three feasibility maps over stiffness and time step for Euler, RK4, and a positive implicit method.
assets.caption: The positive update preserves non-negativity throughout the tested grid.

assets.alt: Cost-error, invariant-drift, and adaptive-tolerance panels for conservative time integration.
assets.caption: Physical feasibility has an explicit computational and accuracy trade-off.

assets.alt: Two policy-simplex maps showing claim reliability and true discovery rate under novelty, rigour, and replication weights.
assets.caption: No single incentive corner maximises both reliability and discovery in the synthetic field.

assets.alt: Reliability-discovery frontier, mean-field cross-check, and population-size sensitivity.
assets.caption: The policy trade-off is checked across seed ensembles, a mean-field approximation, and field size.

assets.alt: Time series of evolved novelty, rigour, replication propensity, and field reliability under three policies.
assets.caption: Incentives reshape laboratory strategies before changing field-level reliability.

assets.alt: Synthetic asset and volatility paths with loss distributions and turnover-loss comparison.
assets.caption: Rough volatility and transaction costs turn frequent delta correction into a turnover problem.

assets.alt: Annotated held-out CVaR and turnover matrices for full delta, fixed-band, and robust-band hedging.
assets.caption: One frozen band is evaluated across unseen roughness and cost regimes.

assets.alt: Robust tuning objective, tail-risk-turnover frontier, and time-grid martingale diagnostics.
assets.caption: The selected band reduces held-out turnover and tail loss within the synthetic simulator.

assets.alt: True and ensemble-predicted toggle-switch trajectories under strong and suppressive held-out interventions.
assets.caption: Structural constraints alter extrapolation but do not automatically calibrate uncertainty.

assets.alt: Generating, unconstrained, and sign-structured learned phase fields for a synthetic gene toggle.
assets.caption: Intervention forecasts inherit the geometry and failure modes of the learned vector field.

assets.alt: Held-out trajectory error, interval coverage, and ODE-solver tolerance panels.
assets.caption: Lower trajectory error does not guarantee calibrated uncertainty under intervention shift.

assets.alt: Exact equation-recovery curves for raw and dimensionally filtered searches across four benchmarks.
assets.caption: Dimensional filtering helps only when physical dimensions remove plausible alternatives.

assets.alt: Candidate cloud, adversarial unit-shift error, and search-space-reduction panels.
assets.caption: Unit consistency acts as both a search prior and an adversarial validity test.

assets.alt: Bootstrap winner frequencies for raw and dimensionally constrained drag equations.
assets.caption: Constraint filtering changes the genealogy of equations selected from noisy small samples.

assets.alt: Uncontrolled and locally controlled excitation-wave fields with the corresponding applied current.
assets.caption: A sensor-triggered local refractory barrier intercepts the representative travelling wave.

assets.alt: Training maps of blocking probability and control energy over pulse amplitude and duration.
assets.caption: The lowest-energy reliable policy lies near a narrow blocking boundary.

assets.alt: Energy-success frontier, held-out policy comparison, and grid-time refinement.
assets.caption: The local controller is compared with no control and periodic global forcing under unseen conduction and delay scenarios.

assets.alt: Robust predictive-separation scores over forcing amplitude and frequency, with response magnitude comparison.
assets.caption: The most informative forcing is not simply the largest forcing.

assets.alt: Posterior probability paths for three true oscillator families under fixed, adaptive, and oracle experiment schedules.
assets.caption: Adaptive experiments contract different model posteriors at different rates.

assets.alt: Identification accuracy, Brier score, and solver-tolerance panels.
assets.caption: Adaptive design is judged by probability quality as well as final model labels.

assets.alt: Two academic line-and-interval charts comparing person-weighted classroom CO2 exposure and fan-energy proxy across nominal, room-change, capacity-derating, and combined-stress conditions.
assets.caption: Four controllers are evaluated on 120 matched synthetic days per condition; error bars are bootstrap 95% intervals.

assets.alt: A three-classroom shared-fan schematic beside CO2 and occupancy traces for a representative combined-stress school day.
assets.caption: The shared command budget couples three well-mixed classroom mass balances under time-varying occupancy.

assets.alt: Five-stage methodology diagram from timetable and measured state through short forecasting, constrained airflow allocation, and room-change plus capacity stress testing.
assets.caption: The evidence pipeline separates occupancy information, controller state, predictive allocation, and stress evaluation.

assets.alt: A combined-stress exposure-energy trade-off chart and a sensitivity plot showing exposure and fan energy as the occupancy forecast buffer increases.
assets.caption: The uncertainty buffer produces a modest exposure reduction while increasing the fan-energy proxy.

assets.alt: Two IEEE-oriented line-and-interval charts comparing timely thermal-fault detection and median warning lead time across nominal, sensor-drift, sensor-dropout, and combined conditions.
assets.caption: Four detectors are evaluated on matched synthetic trajectories; proportion intervals are Wilson 95% intervals and lead-time intervals are bootstrap 95% intervals.

assets.alt: A labelled 4 by 4 battery thermal network beside a representative fault trajectory with fault onset, graph-CUSUM alarm, and 60 degree simulation boundary.
assets.caption: The benchmark represents cells as a coupled thermal graph and evaluates whether an alarm arrives before the study boundary.

assets.alt: Five-stage academic methodology diagram from coupled thermal simulation through residual construction, graph evidence pooling, sequential testing, and drift-dropout stress evaluation.
assets.caption: Only the graph-evidence and calibrated sequential-test stages are proposed; calibration and evaluation use disjoint seed ranges.

assets.alt: An interval plot of false-alarm rate against positive sensor drift and a hatched ablation chart under combined drift and sensor dropout.
assets.caption: The robustness sweep and ablation expose the method's detection-versus-false-alarm trade-off instead of reporting accuracy alone.

assets.alt: Two IEEE-style line charts comparing leak-localisation accuracy across pressure noise and sensor dropout for four placement methods.
assets.caption: The proposed dropout-aware placement is compared with random, degree-centrality, and nominal greedy layouts; error bars show Wilson 95% intervals.

assets.alt: Five-stage IEEE-style methodology diagram from synthetic network construction through leak signatures, dropout-aware sensor placement, localisation, and stress evaluation.
assets.caption: The reproducible evidence pipeline separates the proposed placement step from signature generation, localisation, and Monte Carlo evaluation.

assets.alt: Side-by-side water-network diagrams comparing nominal greedy and dropout-aware pressure sensor locations.
assets.caption: Nominal and dropout-aware sensor layouts on the 36-node synthetic network. The proposed objective spreads measurements across diagnostically distinct regions after sensor loss.

assets.alt: Bar charts of dropout-aware signature separation and top-one and top-three leak-localisation accuracy under the designated stress test.
assets.caption: Ablation and stress test at 8% relative pressure noise and 40% probability of one sensor dropout.

assets.caption: Multilayer network used in the accessible-routing study.

assets.caption: Synthetic traffic-wave heat map.

assets.caption: Synthetic incidence comparison generated by the experiment matrix.

assets.caption: Scenario comparison from the synthetic agent-based ecosystem model.

assets.alt: Population trajectories under fixed-quota, proportional, and threshold-adaptive harvesting with critical abundance levels marked.
assets.caption: A temporary decline becomes irreversible after the simulated stock crosses the strong-Allee threshold.

assets.alt: Finite-horizon collapse probability across normalized harvesting intensity for three policy families.
assets.caption: The fixed and proportional controls exhibit abrupt risk cliffs in the tested grid.

assets.alt: Estimated finite-horizon collapse probability against mean realized yield for three harvesting policies.
assets.caption: The refuge rule changes the tested risk-yield frontier by making extraction depend on current abundance.

assets.alt: Comparative synthetic outcomes for fixed-quota, proportional, and threshold-adaptive harvesting.
assets.caption: A policy is a state-to-action map, not merely a target harvest level.

assets.alt: Heat map of simulated fixation probability across population size and selection coefficient.
assets.caption: Population size changes how strongly sampling noise competes with selection.

assets.alt: Simulated fixation probabilities compared with the Kimura diffusion approximation.
assets.caption: The theoretical curve is used as a validation target, not as a replacement for uncertainty estimates.

assets.alt: Allele-frequency outcomes showing migration opposing local selection in a two-population experiment.
assets.caption: Gene flow can replenish a locally disfavoured allele and maintain a migration-selection balance.

assets.alt: Heterozygosity trajectories with and without a temporary population bottleneck.
assets.caption: A brief bottleneck leaves a persistent diversity deficit after census size recovers.

assets.alt: Correct quartet recovery against sequence length under a compositionally heterogeneous generating process.
assets.caption: More sites reduce sampling noise while concentrating misspecified distances on the wrong split.

assets.alt: Tree-recovery rates by generating scenario, distance estimator, and sequence length.
assets.caption: Methods that converge under the homogeneous control can fail under the designed heterogeneous process.

assets.alt: Recovery comparison across composition contrast and long-branch severity.
assets.caption: Regularized log-det is more robust in much of the tested region but is not universally correct.

assets.alt: Bootstrap support for true and wrong quartet splits under three distance estimators.
assets.caption: High bootstrap support measures stability conditional on the analysis pipeline, not model adequacy.

assets.alt: Streaming sEMG conditioning pipeline with a separate supervisory mains-frequency tracker.
assets.caption: The architecture keeps the per-sample path causal while updating interference frequency periodically.

assets.alt: Synthetic reconstruction SNR and residual rest-envelope comparisons across cancellation modes.
assets.caption: Tracked harmonic cancellation improves the two declared synthetic benchmarks relative to fixed or absent cancellation.

assets.alt: Host-Python fast-path timing and exponential-envelope memory summaries.
assets.caption: Reference latency and smoothing memory are reported separately because they answer different design questions.

assets.alt: S-shaped equilibrium temperature branch of a non-isothermal CSTR with stable and unstable segments and two folds.
assets.caption: The same coolant setting can support cold, intermediate, and hot equilibria, but only the outer branches are stable.

assets.alt: Quasistatic warming and cooling paths following different stable branches of the CSTR equilibrium diagram.
assets.caption: Ignition and extinction occur at different coolant settings because each stable branch persists until its own fold.

assets.alt: Coolant and reactor temperature trajectories during a triangular coolant cycle.
assets.caption: Finite relaxation creates delayed jumps during a dynamic coolant cycle.

assets.alt: Initial-condition map showing cold and hot basins of attraction at a coolant value inside the multiplicity interval.
assets.caption: Returning an input to its old value does not ensure recovery of the old internal state.

assets.alt: Estimated linear recovery time increasing near the cold-branch ignition fold.
assets.caption: The dominant recovery time rises as an eigenvalue approaches zero near the fold.

assets.alt: Methodological effort trajectories under publication-count, moderate-audit, and strong-replication regimes.
assets.caption: Selection on publication count and selection under consequential replication audits move the effort distribution in opposite directions.

assets.alt: False-discovery, expected replication, and publication-output outcomes for three simulated institutions.
assets.caption: Paper volume and reliable information are different policy objectives.

assets.alt: Heat map of final methodological effort by audit probability and failed-replication penalty.
assets.caption: Audit frequency and consequence interact; neither lever is effective in isolation across the tested grid.

assets.alt: Heat map of final false-discovery fraction by audit probability and failed-replication penalty.
assets.caption: The reliability response mirrors the policy-dependent selection on effort.

assets.alt: Selected methodological effort across publication-bias levels with and without a strong replication policy.
assets.caption: Consequential audits reduce, but do not erase, sensitivity to the publication rule.

assets.alt: Nullclines and trajectories of a mutually repressing genetic toggle with two stable equilibria and one saddle.
assets.caption: The deterministic system supplies two memory states and a basin boundary.

assets.alt: Representative Gillespie toggle trajectories at four molecular system sizes.
assets.caption: Finite reaction noise creates rare crossings that a deterministic trajectory cannot make.

assets.alt: Mean first-passage time and switch probability across five molecular system sizes.
assets.caption: The same deterministic phase portrait can support very different stochastic memory lifetimes.

assets.alt: Bimodal stationary distribution with peaks near the two deterministic stable expression states.
assets.caption: A stochastic steady state is a probability distribution rather than a single equilibrium point.

assets.alt: Toggle-switch success probability across induction pulse amplitudes and durations.
assets.caption: Control at finite copy number is probabilistic and depends on both pulse amplitude and exposure time.

assets.alt: Maximum normalized product error over enzyme-abundance and substrate-saturation parameters.
assets.caption: Validity is a region in parameter and task space, not a single universal cutoff.

assets.alt: Maximum product error versus the enzyme-abundance small parameter for several saturation levels.
assets.caption: Small enzyme abundance improves the reduction, but the observed error also depends on substrate saturation.

assets.alt: Full mass-action and QSSA product trajectories for good, borderline, and failure parameter sets.
assets.caption: The initial complex-formation layer becomes consequential when time-scale separation weakens.

assets.alt: Relative half-conversion timing error over the QSSA parameter grid.
assets.caption: A reduction acceptable for product amplitude can still be inaccurate for event timing.

assets.alt: Full enzyme-kinetic trajectory rapidly approaching and then following the QSSA slow manifold.
assets.caption: The reduced law represents motion along an attracting lower-dimensional relation after a fast transient.

assets.alt: American put value and early-exercise premium over stock price and time to maturity, with the optimal stopping boundary.
assets.caption: The unknown exercise boundary is part of the numerical solution rather than an imposed input.

assets.alt: American and European put values with intrinsic payoff, delta, and gamma across the exercise boundary.
assets.caption: Values can agree while derivatives remain sensitive near the free boundary.

assets.alt: American put price error against spatial refinement and runtime.
assets.caption: Grid refinement is reported together with computational cost.

assets.alt: Raw Crank-Nicolson and Rannacher-smoothed values and gamma after the first time step.
assets.caption: Startup smoothing suppresses curvature oscillations caused by the payoff kink.

assets.alt: Heat maps of American put value and exercise boundary across interest-rate and volatility settings.
assets.caption: Price and stopping policy respond differently to rate and volatility changes.

assets.alt: American put values and error-cost comparison for obstacle PDE, binomial trees, and least-squares Monte Carlo.
assets.caption: Independent numerical formulations provide a cross-method audit.

assets.alt: Exercise boundaries for constant and time-varying coefficients alongside deterministic rate, dividend, and volatility curves.
assets.caption: The stopping rule inherits the timing of deterministic coefficient changes.

assets.alt: PSOR iteration counts and complementarity residuals over time to maturity.
assets.caption: The stopping result is accompanied by numerical admissibility diagnostics.

assets.alt: Four snapshots of a two-cell-type Cellular Potts simulation progressing from a random mixture to separated domains.
assets.caption: Differential adhesion drives finite-time coarsening and surface reorganisation.

assets.alt: Heterotypic interface fraction, domain length, and exterior type-A occupancy over Monte Carlo sweeps.
assets.caption: Segregation, coarsening, and engulfment are measured separately.

assets.alt: Sorting index and exterior occupancy over effective interfacial tension and active motility.
assets.caption: Adhesion and motility jointly determine finite-time organisation.

assets.alt: Final cell configurations for adhesion-only, cortical-tension, active-motility, and balanced-surface variants.
assets.caption: Related final patterns can arise from distinct mechanical mechanisms.

assets.alt: Ensemble domain length over Monte Carlo sweeps with an intermediate-time power-law fit.
assets.caption: The fitted coarsening exponent is a reproducible finite-size diagnostic, not a universal constant.

assets.alt: Final cell configurations from random, core-shell, reverse core-shell, and striped initial states.
assets.caption: Multiple starts reveal finite-time path dependence and metastability.

assets.alt: Contact, area, perimeter, and total effective energy over Monte Carlo sweeps.
assets.caption: The Hamiltonian combines distinct contributions and explores a rugged stochastic landscape.

assets.alt: Final sorting index against exterior type-A occupancy for four model variants.
assets.caption: Bulk segregation does not uniquely determine tissue topology.

assets.alt: Cell-circularity distributions for adhesion, cortical, motility, and surface-affinity variants.
assets.caption: Shape statistics help distinguish mechanisms that look similar at aggregate scale.

assets.alt: Seven classical and mechanistic release curves that agree early and diverge at later times.
assets.caption: Early agreement does not guarantee that one release mechanism has been identified.

assets.alt: Radial concentration profiles and a concentration field over radius and time.
assets.caption: Spatial depletion can distinguish mechanisms hidden by cumulative release.

assets.alt: Perfect-sink approximation error over mass-transfer Biot number and bulk-capacity ratio.
assets.caption: Perfect-sink theory has a bounded region of validity.

assets.alt: Time-varying local release exponents for finite-sink diffusion, shrinking core, Higuchi, and Korsmeyer-Peppas models.
assets.caption: A single fitted exponent can average over changing transport regimes.

assets.alt: Synthetic release observations with competing fitted mechanisms and their delta-AIC values.
assets.caption: Model discrimination rewards fit while penalising flexibility.

assets.alt: Sum-of-squares surface over diffusion and film-transfer parameters with the generating values marked.
assets.caption: Diffusion and film resistance can compensate along an identifiability ridge.

assets.alt: Lognormal particle-radius distribution and release curves for single-radius and polydisperse populations.
assets.caption: Particle-size heterogeneity reshapes the macroscopic release curve.

assets.alt: Radial-grid convergence and relative mass-balance errors for matrix diffusion and shrinking-core models.
assets.caption: Convergence and conservation are reported alongside curve fit.

assets.alt: Bulk concentration and cumulative release for a finite sink, with core radius and released fraction for a moving front.
assets.caption: Receiving-compartment saturation and retreating geometry change the release law.

assets.alt: Synthetic returns with marked jumps and a persistent latent volatility series.
assets.caption: Volatility clustering and discontinuous shocks jointly create tail risk.

assets.alt: Empirical, Gaussian, and Student-t survival curves with a Gaussian Q-Q diagnostic.
assets.caption: A Gaussian model can fit the centre while its tail decays too quickly.

assets.alt: Time-varying 99-percent VaR forecasts and rolling exception rates for competing risk models.
assets.caption: Average coverage can hide clusters of forecast exceptions.

assets.alt: Exception rates, conditional-coverage p-values, and expected-shortfall calibration for seven risk models.
assets.caption: Coverage, independence, and tail severity provide different rankings.

assets.alt: Observed confidence and mean VaR across four nominal confidence levels.
assets.caption: Calibration across levels must be read together with forecast sharpness.

assets.alt: Gaussian VaR and expected-shortfall underestimation over Student-t degrees of freedom and jump probability.
assets.caption: Heavy tails and jumps can reinforce structural underestimation.

assets.alt: Block-bootstrap tail-quantile distribution and its propagated portfolio VaR interval.
assets.caption: Tail forecasts carry substantial sampling uncertainty.

assets.alt: Mean VaR against absolute coverage error for seven competing risk models.
assets.caption: Conservatism and calibration form a frontier rather than one universal winner.

assets.alt: Latent and fitted volatility scales with GARCH parameter comparisons under Gaussian and Student-t innovations.
assets.caption: A good volatility fit does not identify the tail mechanism.
